mechanism: Ginseng may inhibit CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 enzymes, potentially increasing allopurinol metabolite levels; allopurinol may rarely cause hypersensitivity reactions which ginseng could theoretically potentiate through immune stimulation.
action: Monitor for signs of allopurinol toxicity (rash, fever) and ensure adequate hydration; inform patient of potential interaction and counsel on consistent ginseng dosing.
